en.name: AGRecorder
en.short_description: Simple audio recorder. Recordings stay on your device.
en.subtitle: Audio recorder, on-device
en.description:
AGRecorder is a simple audio recorder.

RECORD
One button. Start, stop, done. Audio is captured from the microphone as AAC and written straight to your device.

YOUR RECORDINGS
Every take is listed in Recordings, newest first. Play it back and scrub through it, rename it, share it through the system share sheet, or delete it. On iPhone and iPad the files also appear in the Files app.

KEEP THE APP OPEN
Recording runs while the app is on screen. If you lock the phone, switch apps or take a call, the recording stops and everything up to that moment is saved, and the app tells you why it stopped.

ON YOUR DEVICE
Recordings are saved in the app's storage on this device. There is no account and no cloud sync. The app never uploads a recording; one leaves the device only if you choose to share it yourself.

PERMISSIONS, PLAINLY
Microphone access is what makes the app work. Your recordings are never uploaded by the app.

ADS
AGRecorder is free and shows ads from Google AdMob: a banner below the Recordings list and, occasionally, a full-screen ad when you open Recordings. Ads never appear while you are recording. Google may use device identifiers to serve and measure ads. The app does not track you across other companies' apps (no App Tracking Transparency prompt), and where the law requires it (EEA, UK, Switzerland) you are asked for consent first and can change it any time under Privacy choices on the main screen.

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
AGRecorder is a simple audio recorder.

Intended audience:
Audio recorder, on-device

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
No account and no login are required. Every feature is reachable from the first screen after launch.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- Google AdMob (ads): a banner below the Recordings list and a frequency-capped interstitial when the user opens Recordings; never on the recording controls or during a recording. Google's User Messaging Platform asks for consent where required (EEA, UK, Switzerland) before any ad is requested, and a Privacy choices button on the main screen reopens it. Google may use device identifiers to serve and measure ads. The app does not request App Tracking Transparency and does not track users across other companies' apps.
- Firebase Crashlytics, Analytics, Performance Monitoring and Remote Config: crash reports, anonymous usage statistics and performance data.
Recording and playback use the on-device microphone and speaker, and recordings stay on the device unless the user shares one through the system share sheet. The app has no account, no backend of its own and does not use location.

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app is translated into 12 languages (Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), English, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish). Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
The app creates no account, so there is nothing to delete.
